steps.message: Estimate a plan for 900 TOPS units due April 10, 2026. Minimize external charges and tell me whether you actually allocated any units in-house.

reply.answer:
**No — all 900 TOPS units go to outside workshops; nothing was allocated in-house.** The cheapest plan within your 10 April deadline (starting 1 April, deadline day counted as day 10) costs **891.0** in external processing charges and finishes by 10 April.

| Workshop | Pieces | Cost/piece | Batch cost | Est. completion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| W3 BudgetWorks | 230 | 0.80 | 184.0 | 2026-04-10 |
| W8 FreshStart | 300 | 1.00 | 300.0 | 2026-04-05 |
| W5 GiantWeave | 370 | 1.10 | 407.0 | 2026-04-08 |

In-house was left out of the comparison because its cost per piece isn't in the data, so there was no basis to allocate to it — give me a rate and I can rerun with it included.

Risk: medium. Two batches worth 600 pieces are late in their full-redo scenario (W3 → 14 Apr, W5 → 13 Apr); overall chance all pieces on time ≈ 86%.

Assumptions: new batch of original 900 pieces, start 1 April, capacity/queues from the 2026-04-01 snapshot; excludes transport and rework, currency unspecified. Source: workshops.csv.

assumptions: New batches only; each branch delivers finished goods and runs in parallel.

Capacity, queues and reference unfinished-order load are from 2026-04-01, even when the scenario starts later.
Reported cost includes external per-piece processing charges only. In-house cost is excluded by request; transport and rework charges are not supplied.
Currency is unspecified in the source data.
Queue and profile values use the 2026-04-01 snapshot even for other scenario dates.
